channels_hint: Pick the channel in this server that each Discord channel should map to. Channels that could not be matched by name are highlighted.
confirm_check: I understand that this replaces the current Mewdeko settings in this server.
connect_denied: The Discord sign in was cancelled. Connect again to continue.
connect_error: Discord sign in did not work. Try connecting again.
connect_hint: Sign in with Discord so Mewdeko can see which Discord servers you own or administer. Nothing is changed on Discord.
connect_keep_note: The Discord sign in is kept for 15 minutes and the Discord access token is discarded right away.
discord_unavailable: Mewdeko on Discord did not answer. Try again in a moment.
export_failed: The export failed. Try again in a moment.
export_not_admin: You need to own the Discord server or have Administrator there.
export_not_found: Mewdeko is not in that Discord server.
export_working_hint: This can take up to a minute for large servers. Keep this page open.
link_conflict: That Discord account is already linked to another Fluxer account.
link_failed: Linking did not work. Try again in a moment.
link_hint: Prove your Discord account by signing in with Discord, and the XP, balance, warnings and other data you had in Mewdeko servers moves to your Fluxer account.
link_ready: Signed in with Discord as {name}. Finish linking to bring your data over.
link_result_nothing: This Discord account is linked. There was no data to bring over yet.
page_subtitle: Bring your Mewdeko setup from Discord to this server
preview_expired: This export expired. Start again to make a new one.
preview_failed: The preview could not be loaded.
result_held: Held for members who have not linked yet
result_next: Members bring their own data over from their profile page with Link Discord. Their XP, balance, warnings and more arrive as soon as they link.
roles_hint: Pick the role in this server that each Discord role should map to.
servers_empty: No Discord servers found. You need to own a server or have Administrator in it, with Mewdeko in it.
servers_title: Choose the Discord server to move
status_not_migrated: This server has not been moved from Discord yet.
status_waiting_one: {count} member still needs to link their Discord account.
status_waiting_other: {count} members still need to link their Discord account.
warning_body: Moving replaces the Mewdeko settings of this server for every feature that is in the Discord export. Data your members already have here is kept and added to.
wizard_hint: You can skip this and move your setup later from the dashboard.
wizard_subtitle: Bring your Mewdeko setup over instead of configuring it again
